title: Wrap the song detail title
prompt:
In lib/screens/songs/song_page_screen.dart, replace this exact block:
                Text(
                  song.title.trim().isEmpty ? 'Song' : song.title.trim(),
                  style: MonoPulseTypography.titleLarge.copyWith(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  ),
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
with:
                Text(
                  song.title.trim().isEmpty ? 'Song' : song.title.trim(),
                  style: MonoPulseTypography.titleLarge.copyWith(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  ),
                  softWrap: true,
                ),
This makes the full title readable in the header while leaving the bottom bar unchanged. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -q -F 'softWrap: true,' lib/screens/songs/song_page_screen.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/songs/song_page_screen.dart && flutter test test/screens/songs/song_page_screen_test.dart
